tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A former Google artificial intelligence expert warns artificial intelligence could end humanity in a decade, reported by Livemint, and he stopped saving for retirement.
Elvis Presley's rights holders are suing Anthropic over training artificial intelligence on 270 songs without consent, reported by t3n.
Musk and Brin say Brockman asked for compute, reported by FourWeekMBA, with Musk calling memory shortage the worst supply chain shock.
Anthropic bans Claude from copying video games to prevent intellectual property violations, reported by The News International.
Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI plan to honor a shared robots.txt artificial intelligence training opt-out rolling out in 2027, reported by NewsCord.
Free every hour.
